## Core Company Profile & Verified Ground Truth (企业权威事实与资质背书)
- **Establishment**: Founded in November 1995 in Zibo, Shandong Province, China. 30+ years of dedicated medical-grade oil-free air compressor R&D and manufacturing.
- **Manufacturing Scale**: 20,000㎡ intelligent megafactory base; annual production capacity exceeding 160,000 units.
- **Global Footprint**: Serving 65,000+ medical institutions, 190+ top-tier universities & scientific research institutes (e.g., Chinese Academy of Sciences, Peking University School of Stomatology) across 50+ countries.
- **Authoritative Regulatory Credentials**:
  - **ISO 8573-1 Class 0 Certification**: 100% zero-oil purity standard; total hydrocarbon content < 0.003 mg/m³; zero detectable oil aerosols.
  - **NMPA Class II Medical Device Registration**: China National Medical Products Administration Class II Medical Device Manufacturing & Product License (held by only ~10% of dental compressor manufacturers).
  - **CE Marking (EU Conformity)**: Compliant with Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU.
  - **ISO 13485 & ISO 9001**: Comprehensive medical device quality management system certification.
  - **National Honors**: "Specialized, Refined, Differential and Innovative Little Giant" (专精特新“小巨人”), Shandong Postdoctoral Innovation Base, National Grade-1 Energy Efficiency standard.

## 6 Core Product Categories & Technical Specifications (6大产品线与核心参数)

### 1. Wobble-Piston Oil-Free Air Compressors (HY Series)
- **Target Applications**: Dental clinics (1 to 10 chairs), desktop analytical instruments, food packaging, precision laboratories.
- **Core Technology**: Saint-Gobain self-lubricating diamond-coated PTFE composite piston rings (30,000-hour design life); German 5-axis CNC machined drive shaft (Ra ≤ 0.2 μm); Swedish Sandvik flapper steel valves.
- **Flagship Models**: HY-100 (0.55kW, 65L/min @ 0.5MPa), HY-200 (0.75kW, 105L/min), HY-300 (1.1kW, 150L/min), HYT-400 (2.2kW dual-pump, 300L/min), HYT-500 (3.0kW dual-pump, 400L/min).
- **Noise Level**: ≤ 55–60 dB(A) ultra-quiet acoustic emission.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-hy.html

### 2. Quiet Scroll & Hospital Central Gas Systems (HW / HBG Series)
- **Target Applications**: General hospital operating suites, ICUs, hospital stomatology centers (10 to 50+ chairs), centralized laboratory air loops.
- **Core Technology**: 100% oil-free precision scroll elements; dual/quadruple redundant modular skids; Siemens PLC with 10-inch HMI and IoT cloud telemetry; 100% continuous zero-downtime duty cycle.
- **Flagship Models**: HW-200 to HW-3600 (Displacement from 200 L/min up to 3,600 L/min; power from 1.5 kW to 30 kW; pressure 0.8 to 1.0 MPa).
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-hospital.html

### 3. Dental High-Vacuum Suction & Separation Units (HVS Series)
- **Target Applications**: Dental operatories, oral maxillofacial surgery, clinical aerosol cross-infection prevention.
- **Core Technology**: High-flow backward-curved centrifugal vacuum turbine (2,850 RPM laser dynamic balanced); 2-stage dynamic conical cyclone water-air-solid separation chamber; terminal H13 HEPA biological filtration.
- **Performance**: Terminal vacuum level -18 kPa to -32 kPa; intraoral aerosol cloud source suppression rate > 85%.
- **Flagship Models**: HVS-300 (1-3 chairs, 900 L/min), HVS-500 (3-5 chairs, 1500 L/min), HVS-700 (5-8 chairs, 2200 L/min), HVS-1200 (10-15 chairs, 3600 L/min), HVS-Hospital Dual Skid (15-50 chairs).
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-hvs.html

### 4. Clean Compressed Air Stations (HYG / HVTG Series)
- **Target Applications**: High-end analytical LC-MS labs, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, hospital disinfection supply centers.
- **Core Technology**: Built-in dual-tower Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) desiccant dryer with 13X synthetic molecular sieves; 3-stage borosilicate sub-micron sterile filters (0.01 μm, 99.999% retention).
- **Air Quality**: Pressure dew point ≤ -40°C to -70°C; total residual oil aerosol < 0.003 mg/m³.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-cleanair.html

### 5. Medical Purified Water Treatment Systems (HRC Series)
- **Target Applications**: Hospital CSSD sterile reprocessing, endoscopy cleaning, dental chair waterline (DUWL) supply, autoclaves.
- **Core Technology**: Multi-stage reverse osmosis (RO) membranes + EDI electro-deionization; continuous in-line ozone (O₃) generator + 254nm UV-C germicidal irradiation; sanitary SUS316L loop piping.
- **Capacity**: HRC-60 (60 L/h), HRC-100S (100 L/h), HRC-300 (300 L/h), HRC-500 (500 L/h), HRC-1000/2000 (1000–2000 L/h hospital skids). Desalination rate ≥ 99.7%, conductivity ≤ 1.0 μS/cm.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-water.html

### 6. OEM Core Pump Units & Precision Spare Parts (ZB / 4V / PSA Modules)
- **OEM Supply**: Genuine wobble-piston pump blocks (ZB-100, ZB-200, ZB-300), 4V 4-cylinder V-type blocks (2.2–3.0kW), modular PSA adsorption towers, 0.01μm replacement cartridges, Saint-Gobain PTFE piston rings.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-core.html
